template: n_kv_heads went from {old.n_kv_heads} to {new.n_kv_heads}. KV cache at full context fell {pct} ({bytes.old} to {bytes.new}). Standard GQA shrinkage; each attention layer now stores {ratio}x less K and V.
n_kv_heads went from {old.n_kv_heads} to {new.n_kv_heads}. KV cache at full context grew {pct} ({bytes.old} to {bytes.new}). More heads cache independent K and V.
FFN switched to MoE with {new.n_experts} experts, top-{new.top_k}. Total params increased {pct} ({params.old} to {params.new}); active params per token stayed near one expert's worth.
FFN switched back to dense. Total and active params collapse onto a single SwiGLU stack ({params.old} to {params.new}).
norm changed from {old.norm} to {new.norm}. Per-norm parameter count changes accordingly (LayerNorm has weight+bias, RMSNorm has weight only); the difference is {params.diff} across the full stack.
pos_embed went to absolute. A learned position table of {pos_size} parameters was added to the embedding bank. Other position schemes (RoPE, ALiBi, NoPE) cost zero parameters.
pos_embed left absolute. The {pos_size}-param position table is gone; new scheme stores no learned positional weights.
ctx changed from {old.ctx} to {new.ctx}. KV cache at full context scales linearly: {bytes.old} to {bytes.new}.
tie_embeddings flipped from {old.tie_embeddings} to {new.tie_embeddings}. LM head and token embedding now {tied_state}; total params changed by {params.diff} (vocab_size·d_model = {head_size}).
qk_norm went from {old.qk_norm} to {new.qk_norm}. Q/K normalization adds {qkn_size} parameters per attention block; stabilizes attention logits at large widths.
attention_type changed from {old.attention_type} to {new.attention_type}. KV per token is now {bytes.kv.new} (was {bytes.kv.old}). MLA caches a low-rank latent instead of full K and V.
n_layers changed from {old.n_layers} to {new.n_layers}. Block params scale linearly: {params.old} to {params.new}. KV cache scales linearly too.
d_model changed from {old.d_model} to {new.d_model}. Attention QKVO scales quadratically with d_model, SwiGLU hidden scales linearly. Total params {params.old} to {params.new}.
enable_attention toggled to {new.enable_attention}. Attention sublayer params and KV cache zero out when disabled; the block becomes a pure FFN residual stack.
enable_ffn toggled to {new.enable_ffn}. FFN sublayer params zero out when disabled; the block becomes attention-only.
enable_norms toggled to {new.enable_norms}. All normalization layers zero out when disabled; activations are unscaled across the residual stream.
